theorems.statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (D : Set (Rn (m + k))) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m), IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ D → (∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn m)), μHE[k] ({u | ¬ Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ G u)} ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}) = 0) → ∀ B ⊆ D, MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ {u | ¬ Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ G u)} → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun y : Rn m ↦ ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k]) volume ∧ ∫⁻ u in B, φ (ψ u) * ENNReal.ofReal (((fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker (fderiv ℝ G u).toLinearMap).subtype).normDet * (LinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G u).toLinearMap).normDet) = ∫⁻ y, (∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k]) ∂volume
